meta.scope: Cotton web application and server APIs

V1.1.1.notes: Verified decoding before validation in JSON, query parameters, filename headers and WebDAV. Fixed repeated WebDAV decoding; confirmed literal percent-encoded names remain distinct and cannot bypass file locks. Local integration tests passed.

V1.1.2.notes: Verified final-context encoding in email templates, share pages, WebDAV XML and download headers. Fixed shared email escaping and recursive placeholder replacement; confirmed old and new gateway requests retain their content through queued retries.

V1.2.1.notes: HTML email/share pages, WebDAV XML and download-header probes passed. Markdown preview retains unsandboxed iframe srcdoc from file content; a local browser probe confirmed script execution and modification of the parent document.
